title: Design System: Rizvi FE Assignment Portal (Luma Edition)

display.purpose: Exo 2 / Roboto 28px Bold for main page view headings.

body.purpose: Lato / Roboto 15px for interface labels and question text.

mono.purpose: JetBrains Mono for student UINs, mathematical formulas, and parameter chips.

shadows.name: shadow-level-1
shadows.purpose: Resting cards, header navbar, and static containers.

shadows.name: shadow-level-2
shadows.purpose: Interactive hover states, popover menus, and dropdowns.

shadows.name: shadow-level-3
shadows.purpose: Digital assignment paper canvas and sticky toasts.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Fast transitions for button hover, tab switches, and badge pops.

motion.name: transition-normal
motion.purpose: Normal transitions for sidebar expansion and modal fade-ins.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for submit and main CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Lato, sans-serif; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #1889E6; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1577C8; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(24, 137, 230, 0.3); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Lato, sans-serif; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; color: #1E293B; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F1F5F9; border-color: #CBD5E1; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Standard input field with Luma focus ring.
components.html: <input type="text" class="ds-form-input" placeholder="Search assignments or UIN..." />
components.css: .ds-form-input { height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-family: Lato, sans-serif; color: #1E293B; outline: none; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-form-input:focus { border-color: #1889E6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(24, 137, 230, 0.15); }

components.name: Variable Parameter Chip
components.description: Monospaced parameter badge for dynamic student question values.
components.css: .ds-var-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 8px; background: #EBF5FF; color: #1889E6; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(24, 137, 230, 0.25); }

components.name: Page Separator
components.description: Luma section separator with embedded label badge.
components.css: .ds-page-separator { display: flex; align-items: center; margin: 24px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #E2E8F0; position: relative; } .ds-page-separator-text { background: #F1F5F9; color: #64748B; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Lato, sans-serif; transform: translateY(50%); }

narrative.overview: Extracted directly from Luma Sticky App Layout, this design system combines a clean slate canvas background (#F8F9FA) with sticky top headers, deep dark navy drawer accents (#182430), pristine white surface cards (#FFFFFF), 1px structural borders (#E2E8F0), and vibrant Dodger Blue focal points (#1889E6).
keyCharacteristics: Sticky App Layout Architecture (64px topbar, 250px navigation drawer, sticky subnavs)
Section Separators with Uppercase Label Badges (.page-separator)
Dodger Blue & Deep Navy Palette (#1889E6 blue primary with #182430 dark navy drawer tones)
Equal-Height Card Grid System with Level-1 subtle elevation
Dual-Font System (Lato/Roboto/Exo 2 for UI, JetBrains Mono for dynamic formulas & UINs)

rules.name: The Dodger Blue Focal Rule
rules.body: Luma Dodger Blue (#1889E6) must be applied exclusively to actionable focal points (primary CTA buttons, active tab indicators, and progress meters). It must never exceed 10% of total viewport area.

rules.name: The Pure Monospace Formula Rule
rules.body: All variable values, calculated key limits, and student UIN entries must strictly use JetBrains Mono. Proportional fonts must never be rendered inside dynamic variable inputs.

rules.name: The One-Level Jump Rule
rules.body: Hovering over resting Level 1 cards must smoothly transition exclusively to Level 2 (0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)). Multi-level jumps are strictly prohibited.

dos: Do use #F8F9FA for main page canvas background and #FFFFFF for content cards
Do format all dynamic variable numbers and student UIN entries in JetBrains Mono
Do utilize .page-separator divider bars with uppercase label pills to demarcate dashboard sections
Do apply strict 1px #E2E8F0 structural border lines to all card containers
donts: Don't use heavy dark drop shadows or un-layered saturated backgrounds
Don't mix proportional sans-serif fonts inside dynamic formula fields or parameter inputs
Don't hardcode random border radii outside the 4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 9999px scale
Don't alter institutional whitelist constraints or core academic domain requirements (@eng.rizvi.edu.in)
